samples.question: The dashed blue-gray line in this image is a fold crease on a flat sheet. Four solid colored disks (red, blue, green and orange) lie on one side of the crease, and four gray outlined circles lie on the other side; each outlined circle contains exactly one black symbol, and the four symbols are a filled square, a filled triangle, a plus-shaped cross and a horizontal bar. If the sheet is folded along the crease, every disk is carried to the mirror image of its position across the crease, and each disk lands exactly on the center of one outlined circle, a different circle for each disk. Distance across the picture, left-right or up-down order, and which circle merely looks closest do not decide the landing; only mirroring across the drawn crease does. Which symbol is in the circle that the red disk lands on? Answer square, triangle, cross, or bar.
